name: Berrocal de Salvatierra (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a yellow triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Berrocal de Salvatierra (a tower and a bridge on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Berrocal de Salvatierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
